analysis:
Examined all five primary analyses and every replayed patch/metadata unit against the canonical index and supplied TB-002/TB-011 details. No independently supported regression qualifies; this is not clearance of omitted code.

ProviderLoop+Lifecycle.swift:105-125 permits an empty disconnected drain to finish after reconnect grace without asserting coordinator acknowledgement. Native retirement remains required. The disconnect comment is not proof that accepted work is cancelled, outbound usage/terminal frames are discarded, or old authorization is fenced. Review hasRegisteredConnection/acknowledgeDrain and reconnect handling for cancellation, billing ordering and connection-bound authorization (T-010, T-053).

ProviderLoop+StartupShutdown.swift:60-95 replaces exhaustive unloading with bounded waits and can return success with retained slots or outstanding unload tasks. This alone does not establish disclosure or unsafe reclamation. Verify callers proceed to terminal process exit rather than reuse, and that cache clearing at :62 is safe with outstanding native retirement (TB-007, T-028).

ProviderLoop.swift:705-716,868 adds recovery state and saved-selection snapshots; ProviderLoop+Trust.swift:50-54 publishes selection/recovery diagnostics; ProviderLoop+Testing.swift:514-522 supplies internal hooks. No visible change grants authorization or exposes prompts, tokens or private keys. Startup/capacity recovery call sites described in the analyses are not replayed. The production recovery implementation is also absent: review bounded retries, authoritative memory admission, selection changes across awaits, shutdown cancellation, competing residency owners, self-test exclusions, weight verification and cache bindings (T-012, T-027, T-029, T-041).

Test fixture patches show synthetic loading and residency/lease setters, not enforcement of these contracts. Placement/recovery/status assertions cannot resolve the missing production evidence. Replay omits 22 reviewed units; materially unresolved lifecycle and recovery contracts require further source review. No changed encryption, attestation, payment, media-storage or fan-helper control is established in the available patches.
